passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “I will bring upon Pharaoh and Egypt one more plague. After that, he will allow you to leave this place. And when he lets you go, he will drive you out completely.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “I will bring one more plague on Pharaoh and Egypt.
After this plague, Pharaoh will let you leave this land.
When Pharaoh lets you go, he will force you to leave completely.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה ע֣וֹד נֶ֤גַע אֶחָד֙ אָבִ֤יא עַל־ פַּרְעֹה֙ וְעַל־ מִצְרַ֔יִם אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֕ן יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִזֶּ֑ה כְּשַׁ֨לְּח֔וֹ כָּלָ֕ה גָּרֵ֛שׁ יְגָרֵ֥שׁ אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Now announce to the people that men and women alike should ask their neighbors for articles of silver and gold.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Moses must speak to the Israelites.
Moses must tell the people something important.
Every man among the Israelites must ask his neighbor for items.
Every woman among the Israelites must ask her neighbor for items.
They must ask for silver objects.
They must ask for gold objects.
passages.original: דַּבֶּר־ נָ֖א בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיִשְׁאֲל֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ׀ מֵאֵ֣ת רֵעֵ֗הוּ וְאִשָּׁה֙ מֵאֵ֣ת רְעוּתָ֔הּ כְּלֵי־ כֶ֖סֶף וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: And the LORD gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, Moses himself was highly regarded in Egypt by Pharaoh’s officials and by the people.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave the Israelites favor.
The Egyptians saw the Israelites with favor.
Moses was a man.
Moses was in Egypt.
Pharaoh had officials in Egypt.
The people of Egypt lived there.
Pharaoh’s officials respected Moses very much.
The people of Egypt also respected Moses very much.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ חֵ֥ן הָעָ֖ם בְּעֵינֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם גַּ֣ם׀ הָאִ֣ישׁ מֹשֶׁ֗ה גָּד֤וֹל מְאֹד֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּעֵינֵ֥י עַבְדֵֽי־ פַרְעֹ֖ה וּבְעֵינֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃ס

passages.text: So Moses declared, “This is what the LORD says: ‘About midnight I will go throughout Egypt, and every firstborn son in the land of Egypt will die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, to the firstborn of the servant girl behind the hand mill, as well as the firstborn of all the cattle.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Pharaoh.
Moses was a prophet and leader of the Israelites.
Moses said, “This is what the LORD says.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
About midnight, I will go out into the midst of Egypt.
Every firstborn in the land of Egypt will die.
This includes the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sits on his throne.
This also includes the firstborn of the servant girl, who is behind the hand mill.
Every firstborn of the cattle will die as well.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כַּחֲצֹ֣ת הַלַּ֔יְלָה אֲנִ֥י יוֹצֵ֖א בְּת֥וֹךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ וּמֵ֣ת כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֮ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ מִבְּכ֤וֹר פַּרְעֹה֙ הַיֹּשֵׁ֣ב עַל־ כִּסְא֔וֹ עַ֚ד בְּכ֣וֹר הַשִּׁפְחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר אַחַ֣ר הָרֵחָ֑יִם וְכֹ֖ל בְּכ֥וֹר בְּהֵמָֽה׃

passages.text: Then a great cry will go out over all the land of Egypt. Such an outcry has never been heard before and will never be heard again.
passages.sermon: A great cry will fill all the land of Egypt.\r\nNo one has ever heard a cry like this before.\r\nNo one will ever hear a cry like this again.
passages.original: וְהָֽיְתָ֛ה צְעָקָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּמֹ֙הוּ֙ לֹ֣א נִהְיָ֔תָה וְכָמֹ֖הוּ לֹ֥א תֹסִֽף׃

passages.text: But among all the Israelites, not even a dog will snarl at man or beast.’ Then you will know that the LORD makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.
God protects the Israelites.
No dog will snarl at any Israelite.
No dog will snarl at any Israelite’s animal.
This will happen to every Israelite.
You will see this.
You will know that the LORD separates Israel from Egypt.
passages.original: וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֹ֤א יֶֽחֱרַץ־ כֶּ֙לֶב֙ לְשֹׁנ֔וֹ לְמֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה לְמַ֙עַן֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּן אֲשֶׁר֙ יַפְלֶ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין מִצְרַ֖יִם וּבֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And all these officials of yours will come and bow before me, saying, ‘Go, you and all the people who follow you!’ After that, I will depart.” And hot with anger, Moses left Pharaoh’s presence.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Pharaoh.
Moses said, “All your officials will come to me.
They will bow down before me.
They will say, ‘Go, you and all the people who follow you.’
After that, I will leave.”
Moses left Pharaoh’s presence.
Moses was very angry.
passages.original: וְיָרְד֣וּ כָל־ עֲבָדֶיךָ֩ אֵ֨לֶּה אֵלַ֜י וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוּוּ־ לִ֣י לֵאמֹ֗ר צֵ֤א אַתָּה֙ וְכָל־ הָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־ בְּרַגְלֶ֔יךָ וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן אֵצֵ֑א וַיֵּצֵ֥א מֵֽעִם־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה בָּחֳרִי־ אָֽף׃ס

passages.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Pharaoh will not listen to you, so that My wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”
passages.sermon: The LORD spoke to Moses.\r\nThe LORD said Pharaoh will not listen to you.\r\nThe LORD said this will happen so that I may show many wonders in the land of Egypt.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לֹא־ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה לְמַ֛עַן רְב֥וֹת מוֹפְתַ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart so that he would not let the Israelites go out of his land.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a prophet and leader of the Israelites.
Aaron was his brother and helper.
Moses and Aaron performed many wonders.
They did these wonders in front of Pharaoh.
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
The LORD is God.
The LORD made Pharaoh’s heart hard.
Pharaoh did not let the Israelites leave Egypt.
The Israelites were God’s people living in Egypt.
passages.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֗ן עָשׂ֛וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמֹּפְתִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לִפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וַיְחַזֵּ֤ק יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ שִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃פ
